query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'partyType',party_type, 'partyName',party_name,'questions',questions,'requestedPublicationScope', requested_publication_scope,'dueAt',due_at,'status',status,'version',version) ORDER BY created_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) FROM editorial.response_requests WHERE case_id=$1
